bull.b: Substantial liquidity and no debt give Rigetti financial flexibility to fund fabrication, refrigeration, and processor development without near-term leverage pressure. This strengthens resilience while management pursues multi-year technical and commercial milestones.

Strong year-over-year revenue growth, supported by on-premises Novera sales, demonstrates increasing customer monetization. The simultaneous gross-margin improvement suggests product mix and delivery economics can improve as deployments scale, although absolute revenue remains early-stage.

Cepheus-1-108Q provides evidence of differentiated technical capability in a strategically important quantum platform category. High fidelity, fast gates, and a system exceeding 100 qubits may support credibility with research, enterprise, and government customers over time.

bear.b: The company’s cost base remains far larger than its current revenue scale, producing substantial losses and negative returns. Without a major improvement in monetization and operating leverage, continued investment will not yet translate into durable earnings power.

Negative operating and free cash flow show that Rigetti is not self-funding its operations or investment program. Continued cash consumption can constrain strategic flexibility over time and makes successful commercialization, disciplined spending, and access to funding increasingly important.

The definitive CHIPS agreement improves funding for quantum infrastructure but links later tranches to technical milestones and permits clawbacks for non-performance. Government equity, reporting, intellectual-property, and production conditions may also dilute holders and limit strategic flexibility.
